g.text: Open: nothing drives or back-powers them; in

g.desc: Open: nothing drives or back-powers them; in

g.text: use, current sources up to 25.5 mA to contacts

g.desc: use, current sources up to 25.5 mA to contacts

g.text: 1. Function: LP5521 RGB driver for the faceplate status LED (FPT-003, FPT-016 must; FPT-025

g.desc: 1. Function: LP5521 RGB driver for the faceplate status LED (FPT-003, FPT-016 must; FPT-025

g.text: should): three current sources with PWM and program engines; mainline leds-lp5521 (DKMS).

g.desc: should): three current sources with PWM and program engines; mainline leds-lp5521 (DKMS).

g.text: 2. Absent state: faceplate detached: the outputs are open, nothing back-powers. Unfitted:

g.desc: 2. Absent state: faceplate detached: the outputs are open, nothing back-powers. Unfitted:

g.text: 0x32 free, LED lines open. Standby 1 µA with EN high and CHIP_EN = 0 (SNVS441I p. 6).

g.desc: 0x32 free, LED lines open. Standby 1 µA with EN high and CHIP_EN = 0 (SNVS441I p. 6).

g.text: 3. EN on vcca1v8_pmu: always enabled, and the I2C levels follow EN (1.8 V, I2C2). VDD from

g.desc: 3. EN on vcca1v8_pmu: always enabled, and the I2C levels follow EN (1.8 V, I2C2). VDD from

g.text: VSYS_LV 3.8 V through link #22, 0.1 Ω (power tree §4.12: 0.1 A est., 10 mV).

g.desc: VSYS_LV 3.8 V through link #22, 0.1 Ω (power tree §4.12: 0.1 A est., 10 mV).

g.text: 4. Internal clock: CLK_32K to GND; TRIG to GND (SNVS441I §7.3.5.3, §7.3.5.5); INT and GPO

g.desc: 4. Internal clock: CLK_32K to GND; TRIG to GND (SNVS441I §7.3.5.3, §7.3.5.5); INT and GPO

g.text: open (no SoC line in pinout v1). The R channel runs from VDD (R_TO_BATT, BOM line 105).

g.desc: open (no SoC line in pinout v1). The R channel runs from VDD (R_TO_BATT, BOM line 105).

g.text: 5. Each channel is capped at 20 mA in the devicetree (80 % of the LED's 25 mA IF, line 79).

g.desc: 5. Each channel is capped at 20 mA in the devicetree (80 % of the LED's 25 mA IF, line 79).
